I've seen it in my mind more visually as a Shrek type animation, but essentially it's a story about a cow who lives on a slaughter farm.

Everyone around her just eats sleeps and eventually gets led to the slaughter, never thinking anything of it. Somehow this cow is different and she knows it. She could never understand why everyone in her family, all her friends and her community never wondered what else life could bring, why they were so content with being led to death (she doesn't necessarily know that that's the case). 

One day she gets the opportunity she's lived her whole life for. There is a breach in the fence and she slips out of the farm, away from family, friends, alone. 

At first she is very excited, but then she begins to be scared. She doesn't know what lays ahead but no matter what she feels she can't go back to her old life. 

In a series of adventures she meets a friendly and just as curious and eager pig who soon joins her adventure to find out what's on the other side. They encounter some dangerous scenarios, get tricked, learn life lessons and eventually find their way onto a more happier, lively farm. 

This farm is in California and the cows there aren't be groomed for death, but for their milk. They're treated (In their eyes) as princesses, constantly having people take care of them and they genuinely love each other. Its the community she's wanted and searched for. 

The moral of the story is that sometimes we all get stuck in our own lives, heading towards certain death (in a spiritual sense) and seemingly without a care or notice. It's only when we choose to dislodge ourselves from this fate that we see the opportunity we've been waiting for to break free and enjoy the life we've dreamed of. It's not easy, there will be danger along the way, but hopefully with a great and loyal friend by our side we can make it into a great adventure that we wouldn't trade for anything.
